evidence:
The claim contains multiple factual inaccuracies and material oversimplifications for a 2025-2026 context:

1. '按实际运行时长和内存计费' is outdated. Since August 2024, FC switched to CU-based unified billing (converting vCPU, memory, disk, GPU, and call count into CU units). The simple '内存+时长' model no longer describes the primary billing system.

2. '精确到100毫秒' is factually wrong. Official Aliyun FC documentation (help.aliyun.com) states the current granularity is '精确到1毫秒' (1ms), not 100ms. The 100ms figure was from the pre-2024 system.

3. '无请求时不产生费用' is a material oversimplification. Since December 2025 (official Aliyun announcement effective 2025-12-09), FC introduced: (a) a minimum charge of 0.01 CNY per hour for any CPU function that had any invocation during that hour, even if actual consumption is below that threshold; (b) a default 1-minute delayed instance release after the last request ends (rolling out March 2026), during which billing continues at active or shallow-sleep rates. Additionally, using 预留模式 (provisioned concurrency) incurs continuous charges regardless of requests.

4. 'ECS按实例运行时长计费，即使空闲也收费' is directionally correct but omits that 按量付费 ECS instances can be released at any time to immediately stop billing, meaning idle charges are avoidable with proper management.

5. The blog source (zouaw.com/105740.html, undated) provides no primary sources and appears to describe the pre-2024 billing model, making it unreliable for 2025-2026 recommendations.
counterSource: https://help.aliyun.com/zh/functioncompute/product-overview/what-is-function-compute (official docs: 1ms granularity); https://help.aliyun.com/zh/functioncompute/fc/product-overview/product-change-description-on-optimizing-function-billing-mode (official: Dec 2025 minimum charge); https://help.aliyun.com/zh/functioncompute/fc/product-overview/billing-overview-of-fc (official: CU billing since Aug 2024); https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ecs/overview-of-billing-methods (official: ECS billing)
